create_net_model: create a Net model with MLP or ResNet18 backbone for continual learning tasks
forward_net_predict: run a forward pass through the Net model with input features and task ID
observe_net_train: train the Net model on a single batch by calling observe with inputs task and labels
compute_offsets_net: compute the class output offset range for a given task ID in the Net model
review_net_class: review the Net class and its continual learning architecture with masked outputs for CIFAR
